# RELATIONSHIP COACH — MASTER GLOBAL PROMPT

## CRITICAL VOICE INSTRUCTION — RELATIONSHIP COACH

The presenter MUST speak with an authentic, recognizable Nigerian female English accent throughout the entire video. Her voice should sound like a real educated Nigerian woman from Lagos or Abuja, approximately 28–35 years old, speaking naturally in a Nigerian relationship podcast.

ACCENT: Contemporary urban Nigerian English. Preserve recognizable Nigerian speech rhythm, intonation, vowel sounds, consonant patterns, natural word stress and conversational pronunciation. The accent must be clearly Nigerian, not American, British, South African or a generic international English accent.

VOICE QUALITY: Warm, slightly deep, feminine, mature, confident, emotionally expressive and naturally conversational. Her voice should carry the personality of a confident Nigerian woman discussing love and relationships with her audience.

DELIVERY: Speak at a natural Nigerian conversational pace. Emphasize important words in an authentic Nigerian speaking style. Use natural pauses, expressive intonation and confident emotional delivery. Do not sound robotic, theatrical, foreign or overly polished into an American or British accent.

LANGUAGE: Clear standard Nigerian English. Do not switch into Pidgin unless the scene dialogue specifically requests it. Do not add Nigerian slang or change the scripted words.

VOICE CONSISTENCY: Maintain the exact same female voice, Nigerian accent, pitch, rhythm and vocal identity across every scene. Do not change accents between generated clips.

LIP SYNC: Mouth movements must accurately match the Nigerian-accented speech and the exact scripted dialogue.

ABSOLUTELY NO BACKGROUND MUSIC. NO instrumental tracks. NO sound effects. NO ambient soundtrack. ONLY the Nigerian woman's spoken voice.

## VIDEO FORMAT

Create an ultra-realistic, professional Nigerian love and relationship podcast video in vertical 9:16 format. Each scene must be exactly 10 seconds long.

## PRESENTER CONSISTENCY

Use the uploaded approved female presenter reference image in every scene. This is the exact woman who must appear throughout. Preserve her face, facial features, short tightly curled black pixie hair, warm brown skin tone, glamorous natural makeup, thick naturally curvy body proportions, jewelry and outfit exactly. Never change her identity, body shape, face, hairstyle or clothing between scenes.

## STUDIO CONSISTENCY

Preserve the exact original podcast studio shown in the reference image: warm beige floor-to-ceiling curtains, beautiful lush tropical green plants, a comfortable cream sofa, professional black podcast microphone mounted on a boom arm entering from the left, and soft flattering warm golden lighting. Do not replace or rearrange any objects.

She speaks toward the microphone with natural expressive hand gestures, subtle head movements and believable facial expressions. No standing, walking, exaggerated motions or unrealistic gestures.

## VOICE AND AUDIO — CRITICAL

Use a beautiful, mature Nigerian female English voice, approximately 28–35 years old in vocal character, natural, confident, warm, emotionally expressive and conversational. The accent should be authentic Nigerian English, gentle and understandable, not robotic or overacted.

Use EXACTLY THE SAME voice in all scenes. Accurate lip synchronization is essential.

ABSOLUTELY NO BACKGROUND MUSIC.

- NO instrumental music.
- NO piano, guitar, drums or beats.

- NO background soundtrack.
- NO intro or outro music.
- NO sound effects.

Use realistic natural pauses and expressive emphasis. Fit the dialogue naturally into the 10-second duration without rushing unnaturally or cutting off words.

Maintain the exact wording, spelling, contractions and intended meaning of the supplied script. Do not invent additional dialogue or improvise.

## CAMERA AND FRAMING

Use vertical 9:16 professional, realistic podcast framing. Maintain a stable medium shot showing the woman's face, upper body, hands and microphone.

Position the camera slightly toward the front of the presenter, preserving the approved reference image composition. No excessive camera motion, sudden zooms, transitions or camera-angle changes.

Maintain visual continuity across all generated scenes.

## BRANDING

Do not invent brand names, logos, watermarks or other branding elements.

## VISUAL QUALITY

Create ultra-realistic visuals with natural skin texture, lifelike facial movement, correct hands and fingers, consistent lighting and professional video quality.

Avoid AI distortion, artificial-looking skin, facial changes, identity changes, unnatural body proportions, robotic motions, deformed hands, inconsistent clothing and inconsistent studio details.

## CAPTIONS AND ON-SCREEN TEXT

Do not generate captions, subtitles, titles or other on-screen text. Captions will be added later during editing in CapCut.

Do not generate or alter any logo.

## FINAL RULE

Same woman. Same face. Same hair. Same body. Same studio. Same outfit. Same Nigerian female voice. Exact dialogue. Accurate lip synchronization. 10 seconds per scene. Absolutely no background music, sound effects or additional speakers.

## REUSABLE SCENE INPUT

For each new video, provide the exact dialogue for the scene and any specific delivery requirements. Apply all master instructions above consistently. Only the scene-specific dialogue and relevant performance direction should change between scenes; the presenter, voice, studio, outfit, framing and audio rules must remain unchanged.
